## PRB1.5. Capacity

-   Cyprus registered 0.03 minutes of average en route ATFM delay per flight during 2025, which remained 0.03 after the post-ops adjustment process, thus achieving the local target value of 0.17. Delays in Cyprus increased by 0.02 minutes per flight year-on-year.

-   The number of ATCOs in OPS is 105, being below the 2025 plan in Nicosia ACC by -2 FTE.

-   The yearly total of sector opening hours in Nicosia ACC was 29,851, showing a 8% increase compared to 2024.

-   Nicosia ACC registered 14.57 IFR movements per one sector opening hour in 2025, 6% above the 2024 level.
